ledger.x: 1898: after the Spanish-American War the United States takes over Cuba; the military government is installed 1 January 1899 and Spain cedes sovereignty on 11 April 1899.
20 May 1902: the US military government ends and the Republic of Cuba is born.

certainty.note: Whole island assumed; the start year follows the map gap (page dates the government from 1 January 1899).
